reference_resolution.algorithm: Resolve only refs with path, sha256, and RFC6901 json_pointer. Verify sha256 against raw file bytes before parsing. Resolve pointer against parsed JSON, then apply case patches in listed order. No recursive refs, wildcard, fallback, or implicit field defaults.

QPC-009 is a conditional owner transition model. The auth provider and trustworthy owner registration producer remain unbound, so it is not an executable success or product result.

transaction_state_contract.canonical_digest: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with recursively lexicographically sorted object keys, original array order, no insignificant whitespace; numbers/strings retain JSON encoding.
transaction_state_contract.transition_rule: Each case embeds complete initial_state and expected_state. A state is compared by canonical digest and fieldwise assertions. Ref expansion verifies raw SHA-256 first, then resolves exactly one RFC6901 pointer. No merge patch, fallback, wildcards, or default values.
transaction_state_contract.timing_model: Synchronous commit and nextTick preview gate are distinct observations. A failed pre-commit case preserves every tracked field. A failed post-commit preview gate preserves published root/selection/owner and cache call effects while adding zero preview dispatches.
transaction_state_contract.cache_and_generation_rule: commitConfirmation increments editGeneration once. If recordSnapshotCache is called with dataPrepareState=true, markQuerySingleSelectDocumentEdited increments editGeneration a second time and snapshotCacheTimes once. If false, that call leaves both editGeneration and snapshotCacheTimes unchanged; function-call count is still observable as one.
